caption: Table VII-3. 4-point muscle mass scoring system
rows: On palpation over the spine, scapulae, skull, or wings of the ilia, muscle mass is severely wasted.
On palpation over the spine, scapulae, skull, or wings of the ilia, muscle mass is moderately wasted.
On palpation over the spine, scapulae, skull, or wings of the ilia, muscle mass is mildly wasted as evidenced by slight but discernible decreased muscle mass.
On palpation over the spine, scapulae, skull, or wings of the ilia, muscle mass is normal.
note: 原表无表头行，列名为推断所得（左列为分值、右列为描述）
